classdef.name: FootnoteMarkerPositioning
classdef.shortdesc: Options for positioning footnote reference numbers relative to characters the main text.

property.name: NORMAL_MARKER
property.shortdesc: Uses the position defined in the character style applied to footnote reference numbers. For information, see footnote marker style.

property.name: RUBY_MARKER
property.shortdesc: Gives the marker ruby style positioning.
